parent.notes: The zone box on each child card now shows Inside or Outside with the zone name and the time of the last crossing. It switches to a plain Inside or Outside state with no time 10 minutes after the crossing, so an old alert no longer stays on screen. Background alerts from v1.4.13 are unchanged. Login, API calls and the child list are unchanged. Signed ARM64 APK after successful static analysis and tests. No phone testing claimed.

client.notes: Report interval can now be changed from the child app (7 choices, one-time parent sign-in). Tracking restarts when the app opens, and the Health screen warns when notifications or battery optimization are off, with buttons to fix them.
